QuestInfo.name: Explorer's Envoy
QuestInfo.0: Go see the Captain of Nautilus, Kyrin.
QuestInfo.1: Captain Kyrin says the elders of Victoria Island feel they're still not ready to stand against the Black Mage, even with the aid of the Explorers and Cygnus Knights. She believes they need the help of the Resistance. She asks you to travel across the sea to meet with them, resolve your differences, and ask them to join forces with you.\nDeliver her message to Claudine at #bSecret Plaza#k.
QuestInfo.2: Captain Kyrin of the Nautilus said the elders of Victoria Island feel that the Explorers and Cygnus Knights are not enough to face the Black Mage. She told you they need the help of the Resistance, and asked you to meet with them and resolve your misunderstandings. However, it doesn't seem likely that you'll see eye to eye...\n#bFor now, meet with Claudine.
QuestInfo.summary: Talk to #bClaudine#k at Secret Plaza in Edelstein

0.0: Welcome. #b#h0##k, we've much to discuss. I'm sure you're aware that the Explorers of Victoria Island have begun to gather their strength to fight the Black Mage. However, we must face the fact that we have no hope of winning on our own.
0.1: The chiefs of Victoria understand this all too well. That is why we are trying to convince the Resistance to join our alliance. Unfortunately, their past...encounters with Cygnus make them hesitant to trust us. I was hoping you might go see them. Go to #bEdelstein#k and convince them to join us no matter what it takes.

yes.0: They say the leaders of the Resistance disguise themselves as normal citizens of Edelstein during the day. You will have to find their secret plaza without attracting the attention of the Black Wings and find #bClaudine#k. Tell her the challenges we face. Only by working together can we defeat the Black Mage.

no.0: We must all do our part if we hope to survive. If you don't plan to help...I suppose that running away is always an option.

1.0: I was warned you were coming. It's impressive you were able to make it this far...but that is not enough to earn my trust. Who are you, really?\r\n#L0##bMy name is #h0#. I'm here on behalf of Kyrin...no, the Maple Alliance.#l\n#k
1.1: Kyrin... Isn't she one of the chiefs of Victoria Island? The ones who joined forces with that traitor Cygnus? I've heard enough. We've learned the hard way that we can't place our trust in anyone but ourselves.\r\n#L0##bWait! Please hear me out...!#l\n#k
1.2: Leave this town. My mind is made up.

yes.0: We'll not repeat this old song and dance. At the end of the day, you're no better than Cygnus.

npc.0: Go to the Resistance Secret Plaza in Edelstein and meet with #bClaudine#k. Please offer a place for the Resistance in our Maple Alliance.
